forum.title: Missing DSP lib files in STM32Cube_FW_H7_V1.13.0 distribution – CMSIS/DSP library
forum.best_answer_content:
Hi,

Thank you for your reply.

I was being a bit of an idiot. 😄 I hadn't understood that the files needed to be commented out for every directory under `Source`.

In the end, I copied only the directories containing the functions I actually use, and I deleted the files that have the same name as the directory or end with `F16`. For example, in the `TransformFunctions` directory, I removed `TransformFunctions.c` and `TransformFunctionsF16.c`.

Everything is working perfectly now.

Thank you again for your help!

Philippe
forum.content_text:
Hello,

I noticed that in the STM32Cube\_FW\_H7\_V1.13.0 distribution, the folder `\Drivers\CMSIS\DSP\Lib` has disappeared.

Is there a document available that explains how to compile these libraries, and what are the options and defines to set for an STM32H743?

Thank you.
